definitions.full: H110. Adbeel אַדְבְּאֵל proper name, masculine 3rd son of Ishmael (compare Arabic invite, discipline ?) Gen 25:13 ; 1Chr 11:29 (Assyrian Idiba'il etc., name of north. Arabic tribe Dl Pa 301 ; compare Minean אדבל DHM in MV). אדד (? compare Arabic strength ).
definitions.rootNote: probably from 109 (in the sense of chastisement) and 410 ; disciplined of God;

occurrences.englishText: These are the names of the sons of Ishmael, by their names, according to the order of their birth: the firstborn of Ishmael, Nebaioth, then Kedar, Adbeel, Mibsam,
